title: papaver somniferum subsp. hortense
intro: Papaver somniferum subsp. hortense, commonly known as Oriental poppy or hortense poppy, is a subspecies of the opium poppy plant. It is a flowering plant used in traditional medicine, particularly in Eastern Europe and Asia, where it is valued for its medicinal properties and ornamental value. The health benefits of Papaver somniferum subsp. hortense include its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate pain, as well as its role in promoting relaxation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids such as thebaine, oripavine, and hortensine, which have analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and sedative properties.
